blocks.text: 1961 mein Francis Crick aur us ke saathiyon ne yeh khayal pesh kiya: “genetic code maloomat ke tukron (blocks) ka silsila hai jinhein codons kehte hain. Har codon banne wale polypeptide ka aik amino acid tay karta hai”. Unhon ne mazeed socha ke:

items: agar aik nucleotide aik amino acid tay kare to sirf chaar amino acids ka code ban sakta hai;
do nucleotides ka sequence bhi sirf 16 (4 × 4) codons banata, yaani sirf 16 amino acids.

blocks.title: For Information
blocks.text: Proteins banane ke liye DNA mein maujood maloomat ko genetic code kehte hain. Genetic code 3 nucleotides wale codons ka silsila hai.

Is liye woh is nateeje par pohanche ke aik codon 3 nucleotides ka sequence hona chahiye, aur yeh 3-nucleotide sequence aik khaas amino acid tay karta hai. 4 nucleotides ko 64 (4 × 4 × 4) mukhtalif tareeqon se joda ja sakta hai, jo 20 amino acids ke code ke liye kaafi se bhi zyada hain.

Crick ke nataij ke mutabiq genetic code teen nucleotides ke musalsal sequences ka bana hai, yaani yeh triplet code hai. Jab gene kaam karta hai to DNA ke codons mRNA ke complementary (jor wale) codons ki shakal mein transcribe hote hain. Maslan DNA ka codon TAC mRNA mein AUG ban jata hai. Aam taur par “codon” se murad mRNA ka codon hota hai, lekin kabhi kabhi, khaas kar DNA ki mutations ki baat karte hue, DNA ke codons ko bhi "codon" keh dete hain.
